subject: FYI integration 'inert render pass' build fails: nord2_render_pass.inc:145 n2r_rt_load_exact undeclared in workers/integration_tests/inert_render_pass_test.m
body: That test #includes nord2_render_pass.inc standalone (l.245) without nord2_metal_render.h, so your new DontCare rule for raw targets needs either a declaration/stub in the test (as it already stubs other n2r helpers) or a guard. Release and ASan builds both fail; rest of integration is unchanged (CA stride check known). Not editing it myself (your hunk).
